<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" id="Definitions_Internship" targetNamespace="http://example.org/bpmn/internship">
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_Offer" name="Offer"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_StatusUpdate" name="Status update about student"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_Tweet" name="Recommendation tweet"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collab_Internship">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Student" name="Student" processRef="Process_Student"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Company" name="Company"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Twitter" name="Twitter"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_Offer" name="Offer" sourceRef="Participant_Company" targetRef="Event_ReceiveOffer" messageRef="Msg_Offer"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_StatusUpdate" name="Status update" sourceRef="Participant_Company" targetRef="Task_ReceiveStatusUpdate" messageRef="Msg_StatusUpdate"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_Tweet" name="Recommendation tweet" sourceRef="Task_SendTweets" targetRef="Participant_Twitter" messageRef="Msg_Tweet"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Student" name="Student internship process" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:documentation>Accepting an offer makes all other offers invalid.</bpmn:documentation>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_Student" name="Internship search started"/>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_EnterPreferences" name="Enter topic, desired salary, experience and hobbies"/>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_OfferMerge" name="Offer merge"/>

    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_ReceiveOffer" name="Offer received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_Offer" messageRef="Msg_Offer"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_DecideOffer" name="Accept or deny offer"/>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_OfferDecision" name="Offer accepted?"/>

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_InternshipSplit" name="Internship starts"/>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_WriteStatusUpdate" name="Write status update (weekly, at least 3)">
      <bpmn:standardLoopCharacteristics id="Loop_StudentUpdates" testBefore="false" loopMaximum="3"/>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveStatusUpdate" name="Receive status update from company (3 times)" messageRef="Msg_StatusUpdate">
      <bpmn:standardLoopCharacteristics id="Loop_CompanyUpdates" testBefore="false" loopMaximum="3"/>
    </bpmn:receiveTask>

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_InternshipJoin" name="Internship finished"/>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_RecommendCompany" name="Recommend company to list of friends"/>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendTweets" name="Send recommendation tweet to each friend" messageRef="Msg_Tweet">
      <bpmn:multiInstanceLoopCharacteristics id="MI_Tweets" isSequential="false"/>
    </bpmn:sendTask>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Student" name="Recommendations sent"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_01" sourceRef="Start_Student" targetRef="Task_EnterPreferences"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_02" sourceRef="Task_EnterPreferences" targetRef="Gateway_OfferMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_03" sourceRef="Gateway_OfferMerge" targetRef="Event_ReceiveOffer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_04" sourceRef="Event_ReceiveOffer" targetRef="Task_DecideOffer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_05" sourceRef="Task_DecideOffer" targetRef="Gateway_OfferDecision"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_06" name="Accept" sourceRef="Gateway_OfferDecision" targetRef="Gateway_InternshipSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_07" name="Deny" sourceRef="Gateway_OfferDecision" targetRef="Gateway_OfferMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_08" sourceRef="Gateway_InternshipSplit" targetRef="Task_WriteStatusUpdate"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_09" sourceRef="Gateway_InternshipSplit" targetRef="Task_ReceiveStatusUpdate"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_10" sourceRef="Task_WriteStatusUpdate" targetRef="Gateway_InternshipJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_11" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveStatusUpdate" targetRef="Gateway_InternshipJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_12" sourceRef="Gateway_InternshipJoin" targetRef="Task_RecommendCompany"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_13" sourceRef="Task_RecommendCompany" targetRef="Task_SendTweets"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_14" sourceRef="Task_SendTweets" targetRef="End_Student"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
